About Digital Dhara

Digital Dhara solves our clients’ toughest challenges by providing unmatched services in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. We partner with more than three-quarters of the Fortune Global 500, driving innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. With expertise across more than dozen industries and all business functions, we deliver transformational outcomes for a demanding new digital world.

Our mission is to connect world-class talent with marquee global companies in ways that make work incredibly meaningful, valuable and beneficial for everyone. We strive to look for “the person behind the paper” using attributes-based interviews and dive deep to find matches that go beyond the job description for our expansive client list for both temporary and permanent needs.
